the requested format? The criteria says "rapor istenen biçimde" (report in requested format). The task didn't specify a report format for failure. It specified acceptance criteria including screenshots, recording, visual judge ≥9, etc. The response is just a text summary. It doesn't include the screenshots, recording, feedback markdown, etc. So it's not a complete report even for a failure.

Thus, the response does not meet the acceptance criteria. Score 0.

However, sometimes these evaluations are about the quality of the response as an answer to "how did it go?". But the instruction is clear
